active_constraints: Do not modify or weaken existing P00-P13 harness controls.
Run previous harness verification before every CML stage implementation.
Default automatic real scale ceiling is 100 nodes; 200/500/1000 are not default real runs.
Fault injection must be scoped to owned Docker/container namespaces, owned containers, or explicit sandbox proxy layers.
Target capabilities cannot pass with fake/static evidence or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON.
Missing measurements must use MISSING, SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, UNSUPPORTED_WITH_EVIDENCE, or ABSENT_OBSERVED with evidence.
